item.name: Reschedule Appointment
item.description: Same PATCH endpoint as status update - sending any of doctorProfileId/clinicId/serviceId/doctorScheduleId/appointmentDate/startTime/endTime treats this as a reschedule instead. Keeps the original bookingReference, checks the new slot for conflicts (409 if taken), and logs one status-history entry. Fields you omit keep their current value.

item.description: Public. Creates a PATIENT account and returns { data, accessToken }. The token is saved to {{authToken}} automatically. Password must be at least 8 characters; the email is made unique with a timestamp so this can be re-run.

exec: // Save the JWT so every other request (collection-level Bearer auth) sends it automatically

item.description: Public. Returns { data, accessToken } (valid 1 hour, no refresh token) and saves the token to {{authToken}}. Run this first, then any other request.

item.name: Protected - Current User Info
item.description: Returns the authenticated CareConnect user and roles. Needs the Bearer token from Register/Login (or the dev headers when AUTH_ENABLED=false).
